format: JSON Lines; one metadata object per task. CSV has the same fields.

task_id.description: Canonical experiment ID, 1-1614. Not JSONL row number.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 source-code string; 64 lowercase hex digits.

all_grids_within_30.description: Every stored input and output has height<=30 and width<=30.

max_input_height.description: Independent maximum height across every stored input grid.

max_input_width.description: Independent maximum width across every stored input grid.

max_input_cells.description: Independent maximum cells across every stored input grid.

max_output_height.description: Independent maximum height across every stored output grid.

max_output_width.description: Independent maximum width across every stored output grid.

max_output_cells.description: Independent maximum cells across every stored output grid.

oversized_input_grid_count.description: Number of stored input grids with height>30 or width>30.

oversized_output_grid_count.description: Number of stored output grids with height>30 or width>30.

alignment_score.description: Exact released finite cosine score in [-1,1], or null if unknown.

alignment_unscored_reason.description: null if scored; reverse_caption_max_output_tokens if unscored.

maxima_note: Height, width, and cells maxima are independent and may come from different stored grids.
alignment_filter: alignment_status == scored and alignment_score >= threshold; null is unknown and excluded.
dimension_scope: All stored examples, not new generated examples. No dimension enforcement added to generators.
